failure_analysis.observed: Current cup and vase rim fits succeeded at step49 and were used in grasp and pouring targets. The forward-pitch pouring motion reached an IK failure before dispatch at attempted step244 with three balls still visible in the cup. Reverse recovery emptied the cup but later RGB showed balls on the table; subsequent ball recovery disturbed the supported cup and consumed the remaining600steps.
failure_analysis.cause_limit: The chosen pitch differed from the main approach-axis roll in the adopted TRAIN reference; this supports a new grasp/axis adaptation trial but does not prove the alternative will succeed.
